metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the C++20 `iges` CLI in [output](/workspace/output/README.md). It supports all five subcommands, the 87 entity types, native curve and surface evaluation, fixed-format writing, and spec-referenced diagnostics.

The exact CMake command builds from `output/`. I verified 80-column ASCII output, representative geometry evaluations, error handling, and byte-identical second roundtrips. No real-world CAD fixture was supplied for testing.

editorial.last_message: Build and representative checks are supported, not exhaustive conformance. Four cases fail: valid leading-plus integers are rejected, and Type130 uses the general cross-product rule instead of the explicit frozen direct-vector override. Scores remain unchanged.
